exposure: Hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) positive status
cohort: 3,789 HBsAg-positive women and 29,648 non-exposed women from the Medical Birth Registry of Xiamen, China, from January 2011 to March 2018
finding: HBsAg-positive pregnant women had higher odds of gestational diabetes mellitus and cesarean delivery, but no significant difference was found in the risk of other adverse pregnancy outcomes compared to HBsAg-negative women.
birth_weight: Infants' birth weight was recorded, specifically mentioning low birth weight and macrosomia.
